entries.title: Agent-Readiness Scanner — AI Coding Consortium
entries.summary: Is your site ready for the agent web? Scan any origin for agents.txt, ADP policy, AIX index and markdown negotiation — get a grade from A to F.

entries.title: ADP — Agent Discovery & Policy 1.0 | AICC Technical Report 006
entries.summary: ADP 1.0 — the discovery and policy layer for the agent-native web: agents.txt, the /.well-known/adp.json manifest, and HTTP signalling for AI code engines.

entries.title: AICC Core — Level 1.0 | AICC Technical Report 001
entries.summary: AICC Core 1.0 — the normative specification for AICC Markdown, the open standard format consumed by AI code engines.

entries.title: AIX — Agent Content Index 1.0 | AICC Technical Report 008
entries.summary: AICC-TR-008 — AIX, the agent-native successor to sitemap.xml: a machine-readable content index with summaries, content hashes and token costs, enabling differential crawling.

entries.title: AQP — Agent Query Protocol 1.0 | AICC Technical Report 009
entries.summary: AICC-TR-009 — a declared query endpoint that replaces multi-page crawling with one grounded question.

entries.title: Chunk Addressing 1.0 | AICC Technical Report 010
entries.summary: AICC-TR-010 — stable fragment identity for web content: id grammar, stability rules, hashing, and the citation format.

entries.title: Crawl Economics 1.0 | AICC Technical Report 012
entries.summary: AICC-TR-012 — rate budgets, batch endpoints and HTTP 402 payment negotiation for agent access.

entries.title: Agent Identity & Attestation 1.0 | AICC Technical Report 013
entries.summary: AICC-TR-013 — signed agent attestations over HTTP: engine identity, principal class, and verification keys.

entries.title: AICC Interop Mappings 1.0 | AICC Technical Report 005
entries.summary: AICC-TR-005 — lossless translation between AICC Markdown and engine dialects: CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, .cursor/rules, copilot-instructions.md and more.

entries.title: AI Licensing Signals 1.0 | AICC Technical Report 014
entries.summary: AICC-TR-014 — per-resource AI usage grants (quote/process/train) via AIX entries and the AICC-Usage header.

entries.title: Provenance & Freshness 1.0 | AICC Technical Report 011
entries.summary: AICC-TR-011 — source classes, verification timestamps, and a signing envelope for web content consumed by agents.

entries.title: The Agent Web Stack — AI Coding Consortium
entries.summary: The web was built for browsers. The next decade of traffic will be agents. The Agent Web Stack maps every layer the agent-native web needs — and the AICC standard that covers it.
